summary: Akanda Corp. filed a Form 6-K on September 4, 2026, attaching a press release announcing operational milestones from its wholly owned subsidiary First Towers Fiber Corp. (FTF). FTF collected its first cash lease payment from a 200-km fiber network in Mexico, submitted a second invoice, and expects full operational acceptance by December 2026. The company is discussing additional fiber kilometers with its client, and its 28-cell tower portfolio remains fully active. This is routine operational disclosure, not a special situation, with no transaction, strategic review, or management change event.
